  PROBLEM: The README wrapper examples omit `id-token: write`, so consumers using them cannot start clarify, plan, or implement runs after the reusable workflows require that permission.
  WHY: A consumer that set up its wrappers from these README examples gets a caller-level id-token of none. GitHub then refuses to start the run, because the nested job heal-report asks for id-token: write and the caller allows only none. This happens on every issue-opened, /answer and /approved event, before any job runs, not only when a heal report is needed. As a result clarify, plan and implement stop working entirely for those consumers.
